'''Merich's Bend Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ifeoma (city)|Ifeoma]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Ifeoma|same name]]. The [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Saahir Ru'luv]] performed to a packed audience in the cantina.<ref name="LAD" />
